note: Flat images wanted by the mansion (free image route, like experiments/2026-10-05-outdoors). Floors are seamless top-down tiles of one 5-ft cell; hangings are keyed cards.

flats.desc: Seamless top-down floor of polished pale marble: big square slabs (four to the 5-ft cell, so 30 in each) of creamy white marble with soft grey and ochre veining, laid square to the grid with thin joints, each slab's corners clipped so that a small dark moss-green marble square (about 5 in) sits at every crossing. Gentle wear, no gloss highlights, no blue. The pattern must tile exactly on the 5-ft cell.

Seamless top-down floor of panel parquet: each 30-in square panel is a frame of honey oak holding a diagonal lattice of interlaced darker walnut strips with small square oak blocks between (the classic palace parquet), panels divided by straight oak boards; four panels to the 5-ft cell. Polished but matte, warm honey and brown, slight tone variation between blocks. The pattern must tile exactly on the 5-ft cell.

Seamless top-down floor of small patterned clay tiles: 6-in tiles (ten to the 5-ft cell) in terracotta red, cream, ochre and black, laid as a repeating geometric carpet of eight-pointed stars inside squares with a little quatrefoil at each crossing. Matte, slightly worn, a few tiles a shade darker. No blue. The pattern must tile exactly on the 5-ft cell.

Seamless top-down ground of a close-mown formal lawn: very short, even, rich green grass with broad mowing stripes, one light and one darker stripe each 30 in wide running straight across the tile (two stripes to the 5-ft cell, so stripes continue from cell to cell). No flowers, no bare patches, no path. Painted texture, not photographic.

A framed still life seen flat from the front: a chunky carved gilt frame round a dark warm-brown canvas showing (s1) a heap of fruit, a silver jug and a cut pie on a draped table, (s2) a big vase of red, cream and ochre flowers. No people, no text, no blue. Keyed card, landscape format about 36 x 30 in.

Two more framed landscapes so a wall of pictures is not one picture repeated: (s2) an autumn park with a great oak, a distant house and a cream evening sky; (s3) golden harvest fields and rolling hills under ochre and rose clouds. Chunky gilt frames. No people, no text, skies cream, rose and ochre rather than blue.

A large woven wall tapestry seen flat from the front, hanging from a thick rod with a fringed lower edge: (s1) a 'verdure' of dense moss-green foliage, big leaves and ochre and red flowers with a wide burgundy border of fruit swags; (s2) a formal garden scene with a fountain, clipped trees and urns in ochre, green and cream. No people, no animals, no text, no blue. Keyed card about 8 x 6 ft.

Two more grand carpets seen from straight above: (s2) a pale carpet of cream and sage green with a big rose-and-ochre flower medallion at the centre and garlands in the corners; (s3) a deep burgundy carpet with an all-over ochre and moss-green palmette pattern and three borders. Short fringe at the two short ends. Keyed card about 9 x 14 ft.

Tall window drapes seen flat from the front, to stand in front of the tall mansion window (5 ft wide x 8 ft): a deep shaped pelmet with a gold fringe across the top and two heavy curtains tied back to the sides with tasselled cords, the middle open (keyed out): (s2) burgundy damask with gold trim, (s3) moss-green velvet with ochre trim.

A white damask tablecloth seen from straight above, laid on the long dining table: a long cream-white rectangle with a faint woven leaf pattern, crisp ironed fold lines in a grid and a narrow hem. Keyed card, 4 x 12 ft.
A long narrow table runner seen from straight above: burgundy silk with an ochre embroidered vine down its length and a tassel at each pointed end. Keyed card, 16 in x 10 ft.
